Guidance & outlook: The outlook has been below normal monsoon by the IMD and also the rainfall distribution continues to be uneven.
So as of now, the outlook till September looks positive.
And I have in last call also, in the last quarter I have said upwards of 15,000 numbers we will aim to reach, close to 20,000 numbers we will aim to reach in FY '30.
Growth & demand: So I'm happy to mention that during the quarter, the power tiller business has grown to roughly 18% of growth in terms of volume.
Power weeder has recorded an impressive growth of 56%.
So the revenue for the current quarter is INR313.4 crores over INR282.4 crores for the same quarter last year, which is 11% growth.
Margins & costs: Operational EBITDA where we exclude the other income and fair value gain from the EBITDA is standing at 12.85%.
This is largely due to the raw material cost due to the inflationary trend that has been largely the reason for impact.
See, the current cost of that technology on the tractor is about 25%, 30% of -- it will go up.
Capex & expansion: All the verticals businesses have plant growth strategies that are being implemented.
We are scaling up our capability in terms of capacity, people.
So in all areas of SFM, in all areas of tractors, we are expanding coverage through tractor dealership expansion and in SFM through both distributor counter expansion as well as dealer expansion.
Risks & challenges: Natural rubber also -- prices of natural rubber also remain elevated and volatile.
Due to the geopolitical and supply chain -related disruption, crude and freight costs remain high.

Guidance & outlook: I would request management to commence the session with their opening remarks on the current tractor demand environment and outlook for FY27.

Do you believe mechanization penetration among small and marginal farmer is at inflection point right now and what expected midterm growth you expect in this sector? power weeders and tillers are a great potential like I've always said 70% to 80% of Indian farmers are small and marginal and there is a tremendous is opportunity for growth here.
We expect this share to increase to nearly 20% this year and continue growing further, similar to the trend seen in the tractor industry.
Growth & demand: I believe the industry volume is likely to remain ar ound the 10-11 lakh range.
And sir, replacement demand has been one of the key factors in overall strong volume growth over the years.
In the power tiller segment, we hold a market share of around 70% -75%, and Chinese imports are not permitted in this segment.
Margins & costs: We have also got some price increases where in , for example, the power tiller business is largely dependent on the price set by the government for subsidy. there we have got price increases upwards of 2 -3%. then there is the effi ciency improvement with TOC implementation in our supply chain that we have seen, and we have been able to optimally maintain ou…
Secondly also the cost reduction that we have received is in the of 2 to 3%.

However, for tractors above 50 HP, the implementation of technologies such as DOC, DPF, and CRDI significantly increases costs, with the impact varying between 20% and 30% depending on the manufacturer.
Capex & expansion: And this would be a JV or a full 100% acquisition.
It's too early to say anything on that. it will be an acquisition.
So, our strategy is focused on both product launches and geographical expansion.
Risks & challenges: Looking ahead to FY27, the environment remains uncertain.
On the global front, business conditions remain challenging due to inflationary pressures and weakness in Europe arising from the ongoing war situation.

That said, it is very difficult to predict how this trend will evolve because whenever inflationary pressures rise, or there is stress related to monsoon and water availability, the proportion of first-time buyers typically declines.

Guidance & outlook: Moving on to the sales volume for the full financial year first FY26 against FY 25.

In FY26 we registered a growth of 25% and in the previous call I had made a statement that if we are able to do around 23% to 26% continuously on a CAGR up till FY30 we will get to our goal of INR3 ,000 crores.
And also on the last call, I have said we are moving with all the operational efficiency and the work we are doing, we are moving more towards 13% and 13% plus than the 11% guidance.
Growth & demand: I'm very pleased to inform all of you that we have registered a very strong growth of 25% in our overall revenue for the year.
We have registered a healthy growth of 18% on overall annual volume.
If you look at only the Q4 performance, we have registered a revenue growth of 9%, which is INR328 crores, against INR301 crores in the quarter last year.
Margins & costs: So if we exclude that number we are at a strong 14.2% of operational EBITDA against 13.4%, which is roughly 80 basis points of improvement.
Also on the operational EBITDA there's a strong improvement of 220 basis point from 11.2% to 13.4%.

We grow at 25%, but the realities, the uncertainties are in front of us.
